provenance: Non-English lines were drafted by an AI and read by one native Urdu speaker, who judged them accurate. They are not real customer messages.

faq.answer: Our cakes start at Rs 2,500 for 1 pound and Rs 4,500 for 2 pounds. Cupcakes are Rs 250 each, minimum 6.
We are open Monday to Saturday, 10am to 8pm. We are closed on Sundays.
We are at Shop 4, Khayaban-e-Bukhari, DHA Phase 6, Karachi. Pickup is from the shop.
We deliver in DHA, Clifton, PECHS and Gulshan. Delivery is Rs 300. Orders placed before 2pm can be delivered the same day.
You can pay cash on delivery, by bank transfer, or with Easypaisa or JazzCash. We do not take cards.
Custom designs need 2 days' notice. Send us a picture of the design and the size you want, and we will confirm the price.
Eggless cakes are available on request at no extra charge. We do not make sugar-free cakes.
You can change or cancel an order up to 24 hours before pickup or delivery. After that the cake is already being made and we cannot refund it.
